newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Crown says not eyeing Reef.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Crown says not eyeing Reef.

text.p: Australian casino company Crown Ltd said on Monday it was not interested in acquiring the troubled Reef Casino at Cairns in north Queensland state.
"I am not a Cairns buyer," Crown chairman Lloyd Williams said in answer to a reporter's question.
The loss-making Reef Casino, owned by the listed Reef Casino Trust and managed by Casinos Austria International Ltd, is negotiating with its financiers to seek additional capital.
Late last year, financiers withdrew a A$15 million external working capital facility used to fund visits to the casino by high-rolling gamblers.
Williams, speaking to reporters after a general meeting of the company in Melbourne, said he believed small centres like Cairns were not suited to international casino operations.
